answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the thread of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on quadratic conviction weighting that decays rapidly under synchronized voting patterns. Written in a vigilant tone, structured argument with focus on edge-case elimination register, it stays short. The anchor holds work receipts rather than names, so the orchard of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
